statement: Cursor snaps to endpoints, midpoints, arc midpoints and circle/arc/polygon centers of edges under the cursor, with a distinct color dot and a ScreenTip naming the inference.

source.ref: Point inference: endpoint, midpoint, arc midpoint, center

superiority: Inference candidates are ranked by a published deterministic rule and exposed to the scripting API, so an extension can query why a point was chosen.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Scripted hover over a 20-entity fixture; the reported inference type and snapped point match the closed-form point within 1e-9 model units for each of the 4 point types.

statement: Cursor reports Intersection (edge/edge, edge/face), On Edge and On Face inferences with ScreenTips, resolved in the active edit context.

source.ref: Point inference: intersection, on edge, on face

superiority: Also infers intersections of edges with curved (NURBS) faces, which SketchUp cannot.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Fixture of crossing edges and a face; intersection point equals analytic line/plane intersection within 1e-9; on-face point has zero plane distance.

statement: Cursor infers the model origin and the axes origin of the active group or component (its insertion point).

source.ref: Origin and component-origin point inference

superiority: Shows the full ancestry path of the component origin in the ScreenTip.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Hover at the origin of the model and of a nested component; reported inference is Origin or Component Origin, point equals the transformed origin exactly.

statement: Cursor snaps to guide points and to points along guide lines, reporting Guide Point and On Line.

source.ref: Guide point and on-guide-line inference

superiority: Guides are first-class named constraint objects that can be locked, labeled and driven by parameters.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Place a guide line and guide point by script; hover near each; inference type and point match within 1e-9 and tolerance of pick radius.

statement: Drawing tools infer points where an edge meets an active or hidden section plane (On Section, Intersection with Hidden Section).

source.ref: Section-plane inferences (on section, hidden section intersection)

superiority: Section-cut inference works on all section planes simultaneously, not only the active one.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Section plane cutting a box; hover the cut edge and plane crossing; reported types match and the point lies on the plane within 1e-9.

statement: While drawing, the segment aligns to the red, green or blue drawing axis and is colored to match, with an On Axis ScreenTip.

source.ref: Linear inference: red, green, blue axis alignment

superiority: Axis snapping tolerance is adjustable per user and respects custom named axes sets.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Drag a line within 2 degrees of each axis; result is axis-aligned to 1e-12 angular error and colored by axis.

statement: Dotted-line inferences From Point, Through Point (with Shift lock) and Extend Edge continue an existing edge or direction from a hover-acquired reference point.

source.ref: Linear inference: from point, through point, extend edge

superiority: Keeps up to three acquired reference points visible and pinned, with an inspector list.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Pause on a vertex to acquire it, then draw along its extension; the result lies on the extension line within 1e-9.

statement: Tools show Parallel to Edge and Perpendicular to Edge inferences while drawing or moving, in magenta when they lie in a group.

source.ref: Linear inference: parallel and perpendicular to edge

superiority: Also offers parallel/perpendicular to the tangent of a curve at the cursor point.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Draw near parallel and perpendicular to a reference edge; result direction cross/dot product is within 1e-12 of the exact relation.

statement: Perpendicular to Face and Tangent at Vertex inferences guide lines and arcs relative to faces and to previously drawn arcs.

source.ref: Linear inference: perpendicular to face and tangent at vertex

superiority: Tangent inference extends to spline curves and surface edges.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Draw a line perpendicular to a tilted face and a tangent arc; direction equals the plane normal and arc tangent matches within 1e-9.

statement: Rectangle tool signals when the drawn rectangle becomes a square or a golden-section rectangle.

source.ref: Shape inference: square and golden section rectangle

superiority: Configurable list of snap ratios (for example 3:4, 1:2, root-2 for paper sizes).
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/introducing-drawing-basics-and-concepts Acceptance sketch: Drag a rectangle to side ratios 1.0 and 1.618034; the tool flags both, with ratio error under 1e-6.

statement: Arc tools flag exact half, quarter and three-quarter circle sweeps and tangent arcs.

source.ref: Shape inference: half, quarter and three-quarter circle arcs

superiority: Also snaps arcs to common angles such as 30, 45 and 60 degrees as a user-defined set.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/introducing-drawing-basics-and-concepts Acceptance sketch: Drag arcs to 90, 180 and 270 degrees; the sweep equals the target within 1e-9 radian.

statement: Right arrow locks the red axis, left arrow green, up arrow blue and down arrow locks parallel/perpendicular to the nearest edge, in line, move and other tools.

source.ref: Inference locking with arrow keys

superiority: Lock state is shown in the status bar and can be toggled from the keyboard or the measurements box.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Press each arrow while drawing and moving; the result stays on the locked direction within 1e-12 while the cursor wanders.

statement: Holding Shift locks the currently shown inference direction or plane until released, including Through Point locks.

source.ref: Inference locking with Shift (cursor-acquired lock)

superiority: Persistent lock toggle (not only while held) for accessibility.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Hold Shift on a shown inference and move the cursor; the produced point never leaves the locked line within 1e-9.

statement: Pausing over a point or face for about a second acquires it as a reference, prioritising alignment with that point.

source.ref: Inference acquisition by pausing the cursor

superiority: Acquire is instant via a modifier key, not dwell-time only.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Scripted dwell on three vertices then draw; the aligned inference references the acquired points in order.

statement: In the Line tool, the Alt (Windows) or Command (Mac) modifier cycles inferencing between all on and all off.

source.ref: Linear inferencing toggle (Line tool modifier)

superiority: Works in every drawing and editing tool, not only Line.
notes: Acceptance sketch: After first click press the modifier; with inferences off the endpoint equals the raw ray/plane hit; toggling back restores snapping.

statement: Inferences in groups and components are shown in magenta with ScreenTips saying in group or in component, and work from the active edit context and, for hover, from outside it.

source.ref: Inference within groups and components (magenta)

superiority: Shows a breadcrumb of the nesting path and lets the user restrict inference to the active context.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Nested component fixture; hover inside and outside edit context; inference type, color class and transformed point are correct.

statement: Inference engine optionally targets hidden geometry, guide lines and soft edges according to the View menu settings.

source.ref: Inference through hidden and soft geometry

superiority: Distinct display state for inferable-but-hidden geometry avoids surprise snaps.
notes: Acceptance sketch: With hidden geometry shown, hover a hidden edge endpoint; it is inferred, and it is not inferred when hidden geometry is off.

statement: The Measurements box accepts typed lengths, absolute [x,y,z] and relative <x,y,z> coordinates, angles and counts, applied to the active tool state.

source.ref: Measurements box numeric input (length, coordinates, angle)

superiority: Accepts expressions and named variables with unit math, and shows a live parsed preview.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/using-measurements-box Acceptance sketch: Type 3m, [3',5',7'] and <1.5m,4m,2.75m> during a line; end points equal the specified values in model units within 1e-9.

statement: Typed suffixes such as 5x, 5/ and /5 repeat or divide Move/Copy, Offset, and array operations.

source.ref: Measurements box repeat, multiply and divide input

superiority: Preview ghost of every copy while typing; undo as a single step.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/using-measurements-box Acceptance sketch: Copy-move 1m then type 5x yields 5 copies at exact 1m pitch; type 5/ yields 5 equal subdivisions.

statement: Inference pick radius, snap distance in pixels and ScreenTip delay are tunable and consistent across display scales.

source.ref: Axis inference tolerance and screen pick radius

superiority: Resolution-independent snapping with sub-pixel priority rules.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Change preference and verify the pick radius in pixels; result unchanged between 100 and 200 percent display scaling.

statement: Tools infer along user-moved drawing axes and Axes tool alignments; arrow-key locks use the custom axes.

source.ref: Drawing axes alignment and custom axes inference

superiority: Multiple named axes sets per model with one-key switching.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Move axes by 30 degrees; arrow lock red now follows the new red axis within 1e-12.

statement: Cursor infers anchor points of dimensions, text leaders and 3D text insertion points.

source.ref: Inference on dimension, text and construction objects

superiority: Dimensions are inference targets for associative re-dimensioning.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Hover dimension endpoints, text anchors; inferred points match anchor positions exactly.

statement: Edges of imported CAD and image corners participate in inference.

source.ref: Inference in 2D images and imported CAD

superiority: Snap to DWG object snaps such as quadrant, insertion and node.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/importing-and-exporting-cad-files Acceptance sketch: Import a DXF square; hover its corners; endpoints inferred; image corner inferred.

statement: Inference pick latency stays interactive with large models.

source.ref: Inference performance at scale

superiority: Spatial-index based picking holds 60 fps up to 100 million triangles.
notes: Acceptance sketch: 5-million-edge model; median inference latency under 16 ms on reference hardware.
